patient_persona.description: Rohana binti Md Yusof, 44, female, runs a kuih business from home in Seremban, Negeri Sembilan; mother of three, BMI 33; arrives at the emergency department at night with right upper abdominal pain. Breathy, pained, Negeri Sembilan Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Arvind Pillai, Malaysian Indian man in his 30s, surgical medical officer at a Seremban hospital. Calm, efficient; English-leaning, good Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Rohana, pain kat mana? Tunjuk dengan tangan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sini, bawah rusuk kanan. Tembus sampai ke belakang, bahu kanan. Mula lepas makan kenduri, pukul lapan tadi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kenduri tu makan apa?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rendang daging, gulai lemak, kuih pun banyak. Sakit ni datang sekali-sekala sebelum ni, tapi hilang dalam sejam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kali ni dah berapa jam? Any fever or chills? Kulit atau mata kuning?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah three hours lebih, tak hilang. Muntah dua kali. Demam tak rasa, kuning tak perasan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Temperature 37.2, normal. Tapi bila saya tekan sini dan puan tarik nafas, puan terhenti. Itu Murphy's sign positive.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ultrasound tadi tunjuk banyak batu dalam pundi hempedu. Dinding dia belum tebal, jadi ini biliary colic, belum jangkitan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Batu karang ke doktor? Kena operation ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Batu hempedu, bukan batu karang buah pinggang. Sebab dah berulang, cara terbaik ialah buang pundi hempedu, laparoscopic cholecystectomy, lubang kecil saja.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tanpa pundi hempedu boleh hidup ke? After surgery makan macam mana, got any pantang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, the liver still makes bile. Mula-mula kurangkan makanan berlemak, lama-lama back to normal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sekarang saya bagi injection diclofenac 75mg untuk sakit, dan Buscopan. Blood test untuk liver function dan amylase dah ambil.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ada alahan ubat apa-apa tak ada. Tapi saya ambil pil perancang, Yasmin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Terima kasih beritahu, pil tu kita catat, tak ganggu ubat sakit ni. Kalau blood test OK, esok pagi puan boleh balik, dan kita bagi tarikh clinic surgery.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau demam, kuning, atau sakit tak berhenti lebih enam jam, datang balik emergency terus.

patient_persona.description: Lim Siew Eng, 58, female, retired tailor in Ipoh, Perak; type 2 diabetes; ward round on day two of admission for acute cholecystitis. Tired but talkative, Ipoh Cantonese-accented Malaysian Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Yeoh Chun Hao, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, general surgeon at an Ipoh government hospital. Brisk on rounds, reassuring; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 林阿姨，早安。今天肚子还痛吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好很多了医生。昨天痛到叫，今天只是按下去才痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 昨晚发烧还有没有？Nurse 说你的 temperature 37.4，compared to 38.9 on admission 好很多。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有发冷了。可是我肚子饿啊，两天没吃饭了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的白血球从十八降到十二，CRP 也下来了，说明 antibiotic 有效。今天可以开始喝水和吃粥。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那胆什么时候要割？我女儿说 one shot 割了比较好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你女儿讲得对。我们建议这次住院就做 laparoscopic cholecystectomy，最好在发病一个礼拜内做。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我有糖尿病，开刀会不会危险？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 HbA1c 是 7.8，还可以接受。手术前一天晚上 metformin 要停，我们会用 insulin 控制血糖。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我平时吃 metformin 500mg 一天两次，还有 gliclazide 早上一粒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Gliclazide 在医院这几天先停，因为你吃得少，会血糖太低。Nurse 会一天四次 check 你的糖。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Antibiotic 继续 IV ceftriaxone 2 gram 一天一次，加 metronidazole 500mg 一天三次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 开完刀要住多久？我孙子 Saturday 生日。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果顺利，after surgery one or two days 就可以回家。我们排礼拜四，应该赶得上生日。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好好，谢谢医生。那我现在可以吃粥了吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，白粥，少油。今晚十二点以后就要 fasting，准备明天的 anaesthetist 看你。

patient_persona.description: Anand a/l Krishnan, 50, male, logistics supervisor at Port Klang; results review after ultrasound for recurring post-meal pain. Deep voice, direct, Malaysian Indian English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Farah Liyana Kamal, Malay woman in her 30s, family medicine specialist at a Klang health clinic. Clear, organised; English with a little Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Anand, your ultrasound shows several gallstones, the biggest about 1.5 centimetres. The bile duct is not dilated, which is good.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So that's the sakit after makan banana leaf. Banyak kali saya ingat gastrik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Very common mix-up. How many episodes in the last three months?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Maybe five or six. Setiap kali satu dua jam, then it goes. Last time I muntah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: And the liver blood test is normal, bilirubin 12, ALP normal. So no blockage of the duct at the moment.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can dissolve the stones with medicine? My cousin took some tablet.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: There's ursodeoxycholic acid, but it only works for small cholesterol stones and takes many months. Stones often come back when you stop.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Since you have repeated attacks, the recommended treatment is removing the gallbladder by keyhole surgery. I'll refer you to the Klang hospital surgical clinic.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long is the waiting? Sekarang tak boleh ambil cuti lama, peak season at the port.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually a few months for elective cases. If you have fever or jaundice, they'll do it sooner. After surgery, about one week MC.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Meanwhile what can I take for the sakit?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buscopan 10mg three times a day when needed, and paracetamol 1 gram. Avoid heavy oily meals, mutton curry, fried chicken.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: That's all my favourite food, doctor. Susah lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Just until the surgery. Kalau sakit lebih enam jam, atau mata jadi kuning, go to emergency straight away.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Understood. I'll bring the referral letter myself, terima kasih.

patient_persona.description: Jainal bin Gumpil, 39, male, Kadazan-Dusun tour van driver in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; two weeks after laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Easygoing, cheerful, Sabah Malay with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chin Mei Fong, Sabahan Chinese woman in her 40s, general surgeon at a Kota Kinabalu hospital. Efficient, friendly; English-leaning, relaxed Sabah Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jainal, dua minggu sudah lepas operation. Macam mana luka?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bagus, doktor. Yang kat pusat tu sakit sikit bila ketawa, yang lain sudah kering.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me see. Hmm, clean, no pus. Yang kat pusat biasa lambat sikit, sebab di situ kami keluarkan gallbladder.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh drive van balik? Bos sudah tanya. Musim pelancong ni, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau sudah tak makan ubat tahan sakit yang kuat, dan boleh brek kecemasan tanpa sakit, minggu depan boleh mula drive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat sakit saya sudah stop. Tinggal Panadol kadang-kadang malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Makan macam mana? Any diarrhoea after oily food?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada sikit, doktor. Hari tu makan mee goreng basah, terus lari tandas. Normal ka tu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Normal pada sesetengah orang, sebab hempedu sekarang terus masuk usus. Biasanya baik dalam beberapa minggu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buat masa ni, makan sikit-sikit tapi kerap, kurangkan minyak. Kalau teruk, saya boleh bagi cholestyramine, tapi selalunya tak perlu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Report batu tu sudah keluar ka, doktor? Saya takut ada kanser.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sudah. Histopathology tunjuk chronic cholecystitis dengan batu, tiada kanser. Semua OK.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Syukur. Angkat beg pelancong boleh ka? Kadang-kadang dua puluh kilo.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tunggu sampai enam minggu lepas operation untuk angkat berat, supaya tak jadi hernia. Minta kawan tolong dulu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK doktor. Perlu datang follow up lagi ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak perlu, kami discharge dari clinic. Kalau demam, kuning, atau luka bengkak merah, datang semula.

patient_persona.description: Jessica Ong Hui Min, 35, female, marketing executive in Melaka, four months postpartum and breastfeeding; first surgical clinic visit for recurrent biliary colic. Articulate, mixes Malaysian English and Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kelvin Tay Boon Keat, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, general surgeon at a Melaka private hospital. Patient explainer; switches between Mandarin and English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 王小姐，你的 GP 说你生完孩子后胆痛了三次，对吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，怀孕的时候就有一次，以为是胃痛。生了以后痛了三次，最后一次痛了四个小时。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 怀孕的时候荷尔蒙会让胆汁比较浓，所以很多妈妈会长 gallstones。你的 ultrasound 看到很多小石头。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 小石头是不是比较 dangerous？我在网上看说小的会跑出去。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你看得没错，小的石头比较容易掉进胆管，会引起 jaundice 或者 pancreatitis。所以我建议切胆。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我还在喂母乳，baby 才四个月。开刀的话还可以喂吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以。麻醉药很快就代谢掉，醒来精神好了就可以喂。你可以先挤一些奶放冰箱备用。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 手术后吃的 painkiller 呢？Will it go into the breast milk？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 和 ibuprofen 都是 breastfeeding safe 的，只有一点点进母乳。强的止痛药我们尽量少用。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要住院多久？我老公要上班，家里没人帮忙带 baby。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 通常是 day surgery 或者住一晚。回家后两个礼拜不要抱太重的东西，baby 没问题，but no heavy lifting like the stroller。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 费用大概多少？我要问 insurance。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 大概一万到一万两千 ringgit，包括住院。我的 clinic assistant 会帮你拿 guarantee letter。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 等开刀的这段时间，if the pain comes back 怎样？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吃 paracetamol 1 gram，加 Buscopan 10mg。如果痛超过六小时，发烧，或者眼睛黄，马上去急诊。

patient_persona.description: Azlina binti Harun, 42, female, mother of Adam, 14, a secondary school student in Kuantan, Pahang; brings him to the emergency department with abdominal pain since last night. Worried, quick Malay; Adam answers briefly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Jun Ming, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, emergency physician at a Kuantan hospital. Calm, reassuring with children; Malay-leaning with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, anak saya Adam sakit perut dari malam tadi. Mula-mula kat pusat, sekarang dia kata pindah ke kanan bawah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Adam, sakit tu sekarang kat mana? Tunjuk dengan satu jari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Adam tunjuk sini, doktor. Dia kata bila jalan, sakit sangat. Dari rumah ke kereta dia bongkok.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any vomiting? Appetite macam mana, still eating?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Muntah sekali pagi tadi. Tak nak makan langsung, roti canai pun dia tolak. Selalunya dia makan dua keping.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Demam 37.9. Bila saya tekan sini dan lepas tiba-tiba, dia sakit lebih. Ini tanda rebound tenderness.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Appendix ke doktor? Pakcik dia dulu kena pecah, lama duduk wad.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kemungkinan besar, ya. Blood test tunjuk white cell 15, tinggi. Kita buat ultrasound perut untuk sahkan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Semalam saya bagi dia Panadol dua biji dan ubat angin. Salah ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak salah, puan. Panadol selamat. Cuma lepas ni jangan bagi makan atau minum apa-apa dulu, kalau-kalau perlu operation.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Adam berat 50 kilo. Saya bagi IV paracetamol 750mg untuk sakit, dan drip air sebab dia kurang minum.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau betul appendix, bila operation? Suami saya kerja offshore, balik minggu depan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau ultrasound sahkan, team surgery akan buat hari ni juga, dengan laparoscopy. Puan boleh tandatangan consent sebagai ibu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Saya call suami dulu beritahu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Antibiotic kita mula sekarang, cefuroxime dan metronidazole. Nurse akan bawa Adam ke ultrasound sekejap lagi.

patient_persona.description: Chong Wei Jie, 19, male, diploma student living in a hostel in Kajang, Selangor; emergency department visit for 12 hours of abdominal pain. Young, nervous, Malaysian Mandarin with English slang.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Shu Fen, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, emergency medical officer at a Kajang hospital. Warm, efficient; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 伟杰，你的肚子什么时候开始痛的？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 昨晚十点左右，在肚脐这边，闷闷的。我以为吃了 mamak 的东西坏肚子。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在呢？还是在中间吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 今天早上跑到右边下面了，咳嗽都会痛。宿舍的朋友叫 Grab 送我来的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有没有 diarrhoea、小便痛，或者 blood in the urine？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有 diarrhoea，小便正常。就是很想吐，吐了一次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你右下腹这里按下去很痛，还有 guarding。Alvarado score 大概八分，很像 appendicitis。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要开刀吗？我下个礼拜有 final exam。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很可能要。我们先做 CT scan 确认，因为你的 ultrasound 看不清楚。今天开始不要吃东西，也不要喝水。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我可以喝一口水吗？好渴。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们给你 drip，不会渴那么久。Any drug allergy？有没有吃什么药？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 盘尼西林过敏，小时候吃了全身起红点。其他没有。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个很重要，谢谢你讲。我们就不用 amoxicillin 类的，改用 ciprofloxacin 加 metronidazole。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，要不要 inform 我爸妈？他们在新山。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你十九岁，自己可以签 consent，但是最好打个电话给他们，让他们安心。开完刀大概两三天可以出院。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 exam 呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我会给你 medical certificate 和 memo，你可以跟学校申请 defer exam。

patient_persona.description: Meena a/p Ganesan, 26, female, retail store supervisor in Seremban; right lower abdominal pain for 11 hours, initially hides taking a friend's tramadol. Tense, speaks fast, Malaysian Indian English with Tamil-accented Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Hafizah Ismail, Malay woman in her 30s, surgical medical officer at a Seremban hospital emergency department. Steady, non-judgemental; English with this patient.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Meena, I'm from the surgical team. Tell me about the pain from the start.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Last night around midnight, around the belly button. Now it's here, right side, very sharp. Cannot even stand straight.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When was your last period? Any chance you could be pregnant?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Two weeks ago, normal. Saya ada boyfriend tapi kami guna protection.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We'll still do a urine pregnancy test, standard for every woman with this pain. Any vaginal discharge, pain during urination?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that. Cuma loya, and tak ada selera nak makan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your pregnancy test is negative. White cells 14, temperature 38. The ultrasound shows a swollen appendix, 9 millimetres, ovaries look normal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Before I give you morphine, have you taken any painkillers or other medicine since last night?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Just Panadol. Dua biji.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. You seem a bit drowsy. I need an honest answer for safety, no one is going to get you in trouble.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Actually my housemate gave me two tramadol at 4am. Her dentist gave her. Sorry, I was scared to say.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Tramadol plus morphine can slow your breathing, so I'll give a smaller dose, morphine 2mg, and watch your oxygen.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is the operation today? Manager asyik call, hari Sabtu ada sale besar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, laparoscopic appendicectomy this afternoon. IV ceftriaxone 1 gram and metronidazole 500mg start now. You'll get two weeks MC.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Two weeks? Okay lah, nanti I tell her. Thank you doctor.

patient_persona.description: Mohd Amirul bin Che Mat, 31, male, fisherman from Tumpat, Kelantan; day one after open appendicectomy for a perforated appendix. Rough, cheerful voice, strong Kelantanese Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nik Hafiz Nik Yusoff, Kelantanese Malay man in his 40s, general surgeon at a Kota Bharu hospital. Relaxed, uses Kelantan dialect with local patients, English with the team.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amirul, pagi. Tidur baik ke malam tadi?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak berapa, doktor. Luka ni sakit bila nak pusing badan. Tapi dah kurang dari semalam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Semalam appendix tu dah pecah, ada nanah sikit dalam perut. Sebab tu luka lebih panjang dan ada tiub drain ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ingat angin je, doktor. Tiga hari saya tahan, pergi laut juga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lain kali jangan tahan lama. Sekarang dah pass gas? Ada rasa lapar?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kentut ada sekali pagi tadi. Lapar sikit, tapi perut rasa kembung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a good sign, the bowel is starting to work. Hari ni boleh minum air sikit-sikit, petang cuba teh atau susu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Drain keluar 40ml semalam, warna jernih. Kalau esok kurang dari 20ml, kita cabut.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat drip ni lama lagi ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Antibiotic IV, ceftriaxone dan metronidazole, sekurang-kurangnya tiga hari. Lepas tu tukar ke tablet, augmentin 625mg dua kali sehari, cukupkan seminggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila boleh balik ke laut? Musim ikan ni, doktor. Tak turun laut, tak ada duit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya faham. Tapi luka perut tak boleh tarik jaring berat sekurang-kurangnya enam minggu. Kalau tak, boleh jadi hernia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Enam minggu lama tu, doktor. Adik saya boleh ganti lah kot.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Hari ni cuba bangun duduk kerusi dan jalan sikit dengan nurse, supaya paru-paru tak jadi jangkitan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, doktor. Terima kasih banyak-banyak.

patient_persona.description: Ravi a/l Muthusamy, 68, male, retired postman in Bukit Mertajam, Penang; three days of vague lower abdominal pain and poor appetite, brought by his daughter. Slow, hoarse voice, Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Khoo Seng Huat, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, emergency physician at a Penang hospital. Measured, thorough; English with Malay for older patients.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle Ravi, your daughter says your stomach has been painful for three days?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes doctor, the pain is not so strong, just lower side, both sides also. But I cannot eat, no appetite at all.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any fever at home? Constipation or diarrhoea?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Last night a bit hot. Motion also not open for two days. I thought just angin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: What medicines do you take every day?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: For pressure, amlodipine 10mg. For diabetes, metformin 1 gram twice. And my knee, sometimes I take Voltaren.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your temperature now is 38.1, and when I press here on the right lower side, you flinch more.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: In older people appendicitis doesn't always look typical, and it can burst earlier. Blood sugar is 16 and white cells 13.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Appendix at my age also can get meh? Saya ingat only young people.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can happen at any age. I'm sending you for a CT scan now, to check the appendix and also the colon.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: The CT, got the dye? Buah pinggang saya ada masalah sikit, last time doctor said.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good point. Your creatinine today is 110, acceptable. We'll hold metformin for 48 hours after the contrast and give you drip.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Also no more Voltaren, it's not good for your kidneys and stomach. For pain we'll use IV paracetamol.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. Anak saya akan teman, dia boleh sign apa-apa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Nothing to eat or drink from now. The surgeon will see you once the CT is out, about one hour.
